name: LLM Subtitle Translator
description: Translates SRT entries to Chinese via DeepInfra (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct; E2E 实测 Qwen3-30B-A3B 会合并碎片行导致行数契约失败) with chunked numbered-line contract, backoff retries, optional glossary (paste + external file paths). API key is fetched at runtime via localhost invoke, never persisted by the runner.
